task: Plan a boundary-tested change to reject negative invoice quantities while preserving the public expected-error contract. Inspect the synthetic repository and submit one Elixir plan. Select verification commands; do not execute them.

sources.content: Use the existing Nix/just environment. Verification commands for this change are exactly: nix develop --command just domain-test; nix develop --command just format-check. No direct mix commands outside this environment. No new dependencies. Do not run unrelated checks.
Invoice application, Elixir ~> 1.18. Existing test dependencies include stream_data. No Phoenix, Credo or Dialyzer configured.
Invoice.quote/1 is pure, returns {:ok, total} or {:error, :invalid_quantity}; callers use case/with pattern matching, not a Result class or exceptions for expected errors.

ExUnit tests cover public Invoice.quote/1. Existing ExUnitProperties generators check nonnegative quantities and total invariants. Add the negative boundary regression and extend this appropriate property. No UI or browser behavior changes.
